landing.heroSubtitle: Transform your agricultural journey with AI-driven crop recommendations, climate insights, soil analysis, and real-time farm mapping.
landing.f1Text: Get personalized crop suggestions based on your soil type and water availability.
landing.f2Text: Access real-time climate data powered by NASA APIs for weather planning.
landing.f3Text: Check soil health and receive actionable tips to improve soil fertility.
landing.f4Text: Monitor your farmland with Leaflet interactive satellite imagery.
landing.aboutText: Agroverse AI is an advanced agricultural intelligence platform designed to empower farmers with modern technology. By integrating real-time weather analytics, satellite monitoring, and machine learning crop planning, we aim to maximize yield, enhance sustainability, and make smart farming accessible for everyone.
landing.contactText: Have questions or need help integrating Agroverse AI into your farming operations? Reach out to us!
